css: .queue{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#edf2f8;background:#111722;border:1px solid #2a3649;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;min-width:0}.queue header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:end}.queue h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:22px}.eyebrow{margin:0;color:#8ea0b8;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.13em}.count{text-align:right}.count strong{font-size:24px;display:block}.count span{font-size:11px;color:#98a8bd}.controls{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr repeat(3,minmax(110px,1fr)) auto;gap:8px;margin:14px 0}.controls label{display:grid;gap:4px;color:#98a8bd;font-size:10px;font-weight:700}.controls input,.controls select,.controls button{min-width:0;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#182231;color:#e8eef7;border:1px solid #34445d;border-radius:9px;padding:8px;font:inherit}.controls button{align-self:end;width:auto;cursor:pointer;color:#cfe0f8}.task-list{display:grid;gap:7px}.task{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(90px,.8fr) minmax(90px,.8fr) minmax(90px,.8fr);gap:8px;align-items:center;background:#151e2b;border:1px solid #2b394d;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font-size:12px}.task strong{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.pill{display:inline-flex;width:max-content;max-width:100%;padding:4px 7px;border-radius:999px;background:#25344a;color:#c8d6ea;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase}.empty{padding:22px;text-align:center;color:#91a1b6;border:1px dashed #334257;border-radius:10px}@media(max-width:800px){.controls{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.controls button{width:100%}.task{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.task strong{grid-column:1/-1}}

let query='',status='all',owner='all',sort='due';const statusText=v=>String(v||'todo').toLowerCase();const unique=a=>[...new Set(a.filter(Boolean).map(String))].sort((x,y)=>x.localeCompare(y));const syncOptions=(sel,values,label,current)=>{sel.innerHTML='';values.forEach(v=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=v;o.textContent=v;sel.appendChild(o);});sel.value=[...sel.options].some(o=>o.value===current)?current:'all';return sel.value;};const render=()=>{const tasks=api.getState('tasks')||[];status=syncOptions(root.querySelector('[data-status]'),unique(tasks.map(t=>t.status)),'statuses',status);owner=syncOptions(root.querySelector('[data-owner]'),unique(tasks.map(t=>t.owner)),'owners',owner);let items=tasks.filter(t=>!query||String(t.title||'').toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())).filter(t=>status==='all'||String(t.status)===status).filter(t=>owner==='all'||String(t.owner)===owner);items.sort((a,b)=>{if(sort==='due')return String(a.due||'9999').localeCompare(String(b.due||'9999'));return String(a[sort]||'').localeCompare(String(b[sort]||''));});root.querySelector('[data-count]').textContent=items.length;const host=root.querySelector('[data-list]');host.innerHTML='';if(!items.length){host.innerHTML='

';return;}items.forEach(t=>{const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='task';const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=t.title;const own=document.createElement('span');own.textContent=t.owner||'Unassigned';const st=document.createElement('span');st.className='pill';st.textContent=t.status||'Todo';const due=document.createElement('span');due.textContent=t.due?'Due '+t.due:'No due date';row.append(title,own,st,due);host.appendChild(row);});};root.querySelector('[data-search]').addEventListener('input',e=>{query=e.target.value;render();});root.querySelector('[data-status]').addEventListener('change',e=>{status=e.target.value;render();});root.querySelector('[data-owner]').addEventListener('change',e=>{owner=e.target.value;render();});root.querySelector('[data-sort]').addEventListener('change',e=>{sort=e.target.value;render();});root.querySelector('[data-clear]').addEventListener('click',()=>{query='';status='all';owner='all';sort='due';root.querySelector('[data-search]').value='';root.querySelector('[data-sort]').value='due';render();});render();const unsubscribe=api.subscribe(render);
